channel.desc: Sonali Shah showcases some superb Somerset properties to a couple who have a budget of ?700,000 and want a countryside home where they can upgrade an allotment to their very own back garden veggie patch. Sonali also learns about the potentially perilous Bristol Channel and meets the volunteers who operate two life-saving rescue hovercrafts.
